doctrine: AI is AI — one gold in DB; this plugin projects agents/skills into each host's documented agent-doc files. File names and install paths differ by host; content is a projection, not a host-unique fork.

openclaw.notes: OpenClaw injects these into Project Context on new sessions. Projection fills the roster from gold; do not invent a second OpenClaw-only persona.

hermes.notes: Project AGENTS.md / HERMES.md from the same gold as OpenClaw AGENTS.md+SOUL voice. Do not maintain a Hermes-only personality fork. SOUL.md remains instance-global per Hermes rules.

m365-copilot.kind: Microsoft 365 Copilot + GitHub Copilot agent docs
files: SKILL.md (Agent Skills open standard — same bytes as Claude where possible)
M365 declarative agent / appPackage projection when emitting tenant packages
m365-copilot.forbiddenFork: .agent.md custom-agent bodies as the primary distribution (decision #304) — prefer SKILL.md
m365-copilot.notes: Copilot packaging is a host projection of this same plugin. Connector zip is MCP connection packaging, not a separate Copilot product. Agents emit from gold on the fly when needed.

cursor.kind: Cursor plugin agents + skills + method cards
files: plugin agents named by roster (probot, fred, data, …)
optional .cursor/rules pointers (not a substitute for SKILL.md)
cursor.notes: Cursor and Copilot share this plugin identity. MCP comes from the host o-MATIC Server connection, not per-agent secrets.

coverageRule: Every requiredHostAgentDocStandards entry must have a filled projection path from gold. Leaving a host out is a packaging defect.
